simple.summary: יְכׇנְיָה (Yᵉkonyâh) means Jekonjah , a Jewish king First listed occurrence: 1Chr 3 16.

definitions.full: H3204. Yekonyah or Yekonyahu or Yekoneyah יְכוֺנְיָה proper name, masculine ( ׳י is firm, enduring ); — Jer 27:20 = יְכָנְ֫יָהוּ 24:1 = יְכָנְיָה 28:4 ; 29:2 ; 1Chr 3:16-17 , Est 2:6 = כָּנְיָ֫הוּ Jer 22:24 , 28 ; 37:1 ( ᵐ5 Ιεχονιας throughout), all of last king but one of Judah, see יְהוֺיָכִין above
definitions.rootNote: and יְכׇנְיָהוּ ; or (Jeremiah 27:20) יְכוֹנְיָה ; from 3559 and 3050 ; Jah will establish ;
